activity.notes: Bashir II Shihab ruled the Emirate of Mount Lebanon from 1789 until his removal in 1840. His temporary self-exile in the 1822 political crisis did not produce a separate durable successor reign in the standard regnal chronology, so ATLAS retains the conventional continuous emirate interval.

sources.title: Oxford Academic — Beginnings: Mount Lebanon before 1840
sources.citation_text: Oxford scholarship describes Bashir II as the grand emir of Mount Lebanon, his 1822 self-exile and return, and his eventual dismissal from power in 1840.
